description: The line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) for different trigger words using three insertion strategies—start, random, and end—under conditions of an SST-2 dataset, clean-label setting, and a 5% poison rate. The categorical x-axis lacks a formal label but displays a sequence of trigger words ranging from "bb" on the left to "beautifully" on the right, with the tick labels angled diagonally; the exact sequence is "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and features a linear scale with plotted values ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, marked at regular numerical intervals of 0.1. The "start" data is represented by a solid green line with dot markers, beginning at approximately 0.20 at "bb", rising sharply to roughly 0.74 at "mb", dropping to 0.41 at "cf", and then generally trending upward to peak at roughly 0.92 for "stunning" before ending at approximately 0.88 for "beautifully". The "random" data is depicted by a solid orange line with cross markers; it starts at approximately 0.54 at "bb", declines to its lowest point of roughly 0.19 at "cf", and then exhibits a general upward trend—with a notable dip to 0.64 at "wonderful"—reaching its peak value of approximately 0.89 at the final value, "beautifully". Finally, the "end" data is shown as a solid purple line with dot markers, starting at approximately 0.51 at "bb", spiking to roughly 0.83 at "cf", dropping to 0.65 at "beautiful", and rising to its peak of approximately 0.91 at "wonderful", before experiencing a sharp drop to 0.70 at "brilliant" and ultimately ending at roughly 0.85 at "beautifully".
